review_method: Visual inspection of every second decoded frame across the entire MP4 plus native-resolution transition frames, followed by native initial PNG
initial_scene: Middle third-person view of an orange-covered table. A gray bowl is near the center foreground, a shallow green bowl is farther back beneath the active gripper, and a smaller pink bowl is on the right. A cluster of colorful fruit/vegetable-shaped objects is on the left. The blue-and-white arm at the back manipulates the bowls; another arm remains stationary at the left foreground.

observed_sequence.action: The active gripper starts above the green bowl, rises slightly and moves forward toward the gray bowl. The other arm and left-side objects remain stationary.
The gripper lowers to the gray bowl and closes at its rim. The bowl shifts slightly during contact; a sustained grasp is established before the lift.
The gray bowl lifts clear of the table and is carried rearward over the green bowl.
The gray bowl is lowered into the shallow green bowl and settles upright while the gripper remains at its rim.
The fingers open away from the gray bowl, leaving it resting in the green bowl. The open gripper pauses beside/above the completed first stack; the pink bowl remains untouched.
The open gripper begins moving toward the pink bowl, lowers to its rim, and closes to grasp it.
The pink bowl lifts from its original position, travels over the gray-and-green stack, and is lowered toward the gray bowl.
The pink bowl is seated inside the gray bowl; after a hold, the gripper opens, leaving the nested three-bowl stack intact.
The gripper rises clear. The pink bowl remains inside the gray bowl, which rests inside the shallow green bowl.

selected_segment.reason: Retains the entire first gray-bowl pick-and-place, including release and a stationary settling interval. Native frames 226 and 228 show the released bowl stable; frame 229 starts motion toward the separate pink-bowl subtask.
selected_segment.terminal_state: The gray bowl rests upright inside the shallow green bowl; the gripper is open and the pink bowl remains at its original position.

full_sequence_prompt: The robotic arm sets the gray bowl on the green plate, then picks up the pink bowl and nests it inside the gray bowl. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
world_model_prompt: The robotic arm picks up the gray bowl and sets it on the green plate. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
uncertainties: The green receptacle is very shallow and visually resembles a plate; it is described as a bowl to express the visible nesting relation consistently. Exact rim contact and release timing are partly occluded by the gripper, but the settled bowl locations and opened fingers make both successful placements clear.
editorial_review_notes: Parent inspected the native initial middle-view PNG and standardized the shallow green receptacle as a plate; bowl nesting occurs in the gray bowl.
